answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the garden graph. Re-attestations are stored in crystal and ferrous lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1795 identities would post 3842 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
